summary: Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Business Combination Agreement dated August 27, 2026, with Four Leaf Acquisition Corporation (Parent) and its subsidiary FORL Merger Sub. Pursuant to the agreement, Parent will merge into a new Nevada subsidiary (NewCo), then Merger Sub will merge into Data443, with Data443 surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of NewCo. Data443 common stock will be converted into NewCo common stock, with preferred stock converting first. NewCo will seek a Nasdaq listing. Specific exchange ratio, valuation, premium, and advisor names are not provided in the excerpt. What to watch: regulatory approvals, shareholder votes, and closing conditions; risk-arb angle depends on deal terms and closing timeline.
